provenance: x402 specification v2 section 5.5, Settlement and Refusal Identity Invariant, as proposed in x402-foundation/x402 pull request 3776 on branch spec/settlement-refusal-identity-invariant and not on main; checked against commit 2819ed7 (arrival-order query canonicalization) on 26 October 2026
the gap these cover was named by ruiruii in erc-8004/erc-8004-contracts#99 on 18 October 2026: each of the four evidence layers depends on an attempt identity that none of them defines
the section names these vectors as the interim normative home until a permanent location in the x402 repository is agreed
encodes: The positive control for the body half of the changed-request clause: a different body gives a different artifact, established at ingress by comparing snapshots. Query and amount already had this positive control (changed-query-established-at-ingress, changed-amount-established-at-ingress); body only had the silent-collapse negative until this vector.
description: A changed body field gets its own identity, and the difference is established at ingress, not discovered downstream.
limits: This says the difference is established at ingress. It does not say the comparison covered every member of the snapshot.
Covers one changed body field (endpoint). A different field or a nested change is not shown here.
